resources.string: Used exclusively during user-initiated focus sessions and daily app limits to detect when a selected distracting app or short-form video feed opens and display the Focus Shield. All checks run 100% locally on your device; no screen text, passwords, or personal data are read, stored, or transmitted.
Enables optional Device Admin protection and Mode B Device Owner policies (package suspension, Lock Task pinning, and uninstall protection) during active strict focus sessions.
